scope: Read-only independent static review of page geometry, type hiding, corrections, source view, and save/export chain. Product files and ledger were not changed.

source.runtime: R0; public source static evidence only

sourceNodes.finding: getter consumes meta.bboxes, _splitBboxes, then bbox, filters pageNumber; tr2 exact-match tolerance <0.01 else first box. It does not itself produce geometry or rotate source boxes.
filters deleted/suppressed/type/query/score, keeps original index, projects multi-box display geometry and normalized original text; UI list is derived view.
single-item delete and keyboard delete use ordinary rejection flow; source UI does not establish persistent type-hide for Image.
manual full-text additions deduplicate live spans and image path/line/occurrence; only actually added records write FN, no empty append.
Ql2 ordinary single delete; eu2 type hide explicitly disables feedback/FP, while group/multi deletion performs aggregate FP; user-added removals decrement FN.
type hide is deleted tombstone + hiddenByType and captures user-added birth; restore yields pending or user-added and changes no feedback itself.

sourceNodes.sha256Scope: exact inclusive line slice UTF-8 bytes, newline retained
exact inclusive line slice UTF-8 bytes, newline retained

chain: PageEditor text selection (apps/web/page-review.tsx) -> main.tsx onMarksChange -> changeMarks(..., manual-add) -> UI dirty state / feedback and automatic rule dispatch.

Entity geometry UI obtains opaque descriptor from POST /documents/:id/pages/:page/entity-geometries; drag/8 handles edit one box or union of multi-box geometry; page policy stays pending until review save.

POST review save (apps/api/reviews.ts -> saveReview) binds incoming marks to trusted provenance, validates geometry token against source/content/revision/page map+preview hashes and bounds, snapshots and increments revision.

Page export validates policy and marks, verifies original source and each page preview hash, computes boxes from glyph map plus authenticated geometry override, rasterizes, OCR-checks selected values, and reopens generated PDF to verify page count/pixels/metadata.
localImplementation.sourceReview: Markdown source view requires view_original, exact revision, canonical content hash and verified sidecar; response returns source text and mapped candidate spans. Review-provenance endpoint also requires view_original and scopes tenant/project/document; inherited provenance is marked non-authoritative for local review.
localImplementation.corrections: Correction code stores recognizedText/correctedText in correction frame and applies semantic display/search values separately from canonical text; original source hash is verified during source-dependent API paths.

findings.observation: Page selection checks duplicates only among non-ignore/non-hidden marks, then emits a new pending mark. This allows intentional re-add after ignore, but caller semantics depend on the producer label manual-add. Root reported this chain is being corrected and has not completed Edge verification; I did not re-report as a new finding.
findings.minimalCounterexample: Synthetic one-page text with one existing ignored mark; select identical text and add mark.
findings.expected: A deliberate re-add remains pending and yields one feedback FN event; no accidental duplicate parallel to a visible mark.
findings.staticActual: Handler appends the pending mark and main.tsx routes it through manual-add. API review-feedback de-duplicates occupied same-family offsets when computing FN; visible UI may temporarily contain old ignored record plus pending replacement until save.
findings.impact: Review state and feedback accounting; no source byte mutation implied.

findings.status: no new statically provable product defect
findings.observation: Geometry guards reject out-of-page or stale page/map/preview/base geometry; multi-box overrides are represented as a list; hidden type marks are ignored by rendering/export decisions through decision=ignore; source hash and review revision gate original-source UI.

counterexampleCoverage.static: rotation endpoint rebases correction geometry and replaces canonical page/map data; entity geometry validation binds page mapHash, previewHash, base boxes, mark identity and revision. Existing portable/root geometry report reviewed.

PDF getter filters boxes by page; projection preserves displayBboxes; local geometry descriptor and override bind page and multiple boxes. PDF `er2/tr2` is a geometry getter, not deletion-state producer.
pointer edits update region; browser guard reports when out of page and server revalidates bounds. No visual assertion made.

source xc/_c/Sc and Ql2/eu2/tu2 semantics confirmed; local type-hide feedback builder returns no records/counter delta, type-hidden marks project ignored. Existing codec/API evidence reviewed; no new Edge run.

counterexampleCoverage.case: retain original, no FP; manual addition, FN
counterexampleCoverage.static: builder excludes type-hide; manual-add emits FN only for newly occupied locations and reports additions. Existing report API receipts reviewed, not independently rerun.

counterexampleCoverage.case: corrected dual text/type and immutable original
counterexampleCoverage.static: correction frame retains recognized and corrected text; canonical `content`/source are not overwritten by correction application; existing integration report attests synthetic own-image bytes unchanged.
source view route uses projectScope + view_original + revision/hash/sidecar checks; export requires separate export permission and verified source. No auth runtime attempt.
geometry tokens seal document/project scope; source/content/revision/map/preview/base hashes, identity and bounds are checked at save/export.

limitations: No services, browser, Edge, or competitor runtime used.
Source snippets were matched to the existing finite-source-chain ledger IDs and hashes; no new source node is proposed.
Parent Mm2 and four-format apply range is wider than the existing exact rows; only declared finite chain behavior is summarized, not every line in the interval.

geometryTypeHideFollowup.status: static chain resolves safely; combined integration coverage gap

files.finding: prune compares binding identity/start/end only; toggling hiddenByType/decision preserves same slot geometry.
ordinary regions omit geometry overrides; override is consumed only inside decision===redact branch, so ignore hidden mark does not clear pixels.
resolver authenticates retained geometry even when hidden, maps it by mark index; pageBoxes ignores map entry for ignore mark.
shared preview/export plan gates erasure on redact decision; finalClear includes only non-geometry regions.
Word image plan calls pageBoxes with resolved geometry; image output goes through renderDocumentVisualPage using same plan semantics.
save validates identity link and re-signs geometry token for next revision.
tests prune on removal/type identity changes and hidden descriptor filtering separately; no stored-region hide/restore case.
geometry export/residue is tested for visible redact mark; no hidden toggle.
Word hide/save/export/restore lifecycle has no inline image geometry override.
browser hide/reload/restore lifecycle has no entityGeometryOverride.

geometryTypeHideFollowup.restore: restoreHiddenReviewEntities clears hidden flags and sets pending while preserving birth. Binding identity/start/end survives; next review save revalidates and re-signs to target revision. Geometry applies only after explicit redact.
geometryTypeHideFollowup.finding: No static evidence the retained override leaks as a generic region in PDF or Word image export. No existing test covers the combined hide/restore and geometry lifecycle; do not claim tested PASS.
geometryTypeHideFollowup.counterexample: Synthetic DOCX with OCR image and entity: save expanded geometry, hide type/save/reopen and confirm original pixels remain; restore/save and confirm pending plus same binding with next revision token; set redact and confirm adjusted geometry is used.
